www.title: Everchat - Public comments on any URL
www.metaDescription: Every URL deserves a conversation. Anonymous Chrome side-panel comments. No email. No ads. No third-party trackers.
www.heroLede: Anonymous public comments in a Chrome side panel. No email. No third-party trackers. No ads. Free forever.
www.installAria: Install Everchat from the Chrome Web Store
www.chromeStoreBadgeAlt: Available in the Chrome Web Store
www.donateAria: Donate to Everchat via Open Collective
www.benefit1Body: Open the side panel on any tab. News, government, docs, anything with a link. Same URL, same room. You never leave the page.
www.benefit2Body: We do not hire moderators to police speech. Votes collapse junk; collapsed comments stay expandable. Karma marks reputation in the room.
www.benefit3Body: No third-party trackers. No email. Passkeys when you speak. We don't build an ad profile of you across the web.
www.benefit4Body: If many people use it, we may ask for donations via Open Collective to keep the lights on. Donations never buy ads, ranking, or special treatment.
www.installIntro: Chrome Web Store listing is coming. Until then, install an official GitHub release zip. Loading that unpacked zip in developer mode also means you keep a copy if the store ever rejects or removes Everchat.
www.installPrivateNote: The Chrome Web Store listing is not live yet. Install from official GitHub Releases.
www.installReleaseIntro: Download the latest Chrome zip from
www.installReleaseStep2: Unzip it. The folder must contain manifest.json
www.installReleaseStep3: Open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, Load unpacked, select that folder
www.installReleaseStep4: Pin Everchat and open the side panel on any page
www.installSourceBody: The GitHub repository is public so you can review the code, follow the changelog, and send contributions. Install only official GitHub Release zips or the Chrome Web Store listing. Building from source is for review and pull requests, not an alternate distribution.
www.footerTagline: © {{year}} Everchat. Public comments on any URL.
www.legalEnglishNote: This page is in English. The English version is the official legal text.
www.heroMockTitle: Say what you think without leaving the page
www.heroMockMsg1: Finally, talk about the page without leaving it.
www.heroMockMsg2: Same URL, same room. Tracking params stripped.
www.heroMockMsg3: No email. Passkeys when you want to speak.
